start-training.description: Spins up an isolated branch named with the current date and time
steps: echo 'Branch created. Please tell OpenCode in the chat: Initiate the interview.'

hint.description: Requests a tier-appropriate conceptual clue without exposing the code solution
hint.prompt: I am stuck on the current exercise. Based on my interview level recorded in .opencode/session.json, provide a conceptual hint or architectural advice. Do not reveal any code solutions.

submit-exercise.description: Compiles code, runs tests, and creates a local atomic commit
steps: bash -c 'git commit -m "feat: complete daily automated training exercise"'
